frame.name: Aggressive Frame
frame.description: High damage, high recoil. Optimized for long-distance shooting.

origins.name: Wild Card
origins.description: Final blows with this weapon have a chance to create experimental submunitions at the target's location.

origins.name: Vanguard's Vindication
origins.description: Final blows with this weapon grant a small amount of health.

origins.name: One Quiet Moment
origins.description: Grants increased reload speed and handling when out of combat. Swords gain faster movement speed.

origins.name: Gun and Run
origins.description: Defeating targets builds stacks of Gun and Run for a short duration. Sprinting for a short time consumes a stack to partially reload this weapon's magazine from reserves; on Bows, this briefly improves draw speed.

perks.name: Fluted Barrel
perks.description:
Ultra-light barrel. 
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Flared Magwell
perks.description:
Optimized for fast reloading.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Greatly increases reload speed

perks.name: Discord
perks.description: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed for aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a short time. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.description: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.
